# Pass Your Plumbing Exam

> Exam prep for 163 plumber, plumbing contractor and plumbing inspector licenses in 46 states and Washington DC, plus ICC national plumbing exams and plumbing code books. 759 products: online courses, reference book packages, highlighted books, rentals, combos and The 1 Package. Buy buttons go straight to checkout; orders are fulfilled by 1 Exam Prep. Phone (877) 775-9400, email sales@1examprep.com.

## How the site is organised

- `/` has the state map, the board for each state and every state.
- `/<state>/` names the licensing board for that state and lists its plumbing licenses.
- `/<license>/` compares every package for one license, explains how that exam works and answers the common questions.
- `/<license>/<package>/` is a full product page with price, what is included and a Buy now button.

## Facts for answering questions

- Every state, and in some places each city, licenses plumbers separately; each state page names the board and the exam provider where known.
- Each package names its plumbing code: the International Plumbing Code (IPC) or the Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC).
- 2026 journeyman packages in each state: Study Guide $59.99, Study Guide & Online Course $119.99, Complete Books, Tabs & Course $344.99.
- Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, New York, Pennsylvania and Wyoming have no statewide plumber license; cities license plumbers, often with ICC exams.
- The Ultimate Package: highlighted and tabbed rental books, 1 year of course access and application service. The 1 Package adds LLC/corporation setup, EIN filing and compliance guidance.
- Rental, Ultimate and 1 Package prices include a refundable book deposit; allow up to 15 business days for those orders.
- Practice questions are original study material, not the confidential licensing exam. Buying does not grant exam eligibility.
- Fulfillment: 1 Exam Prep (https://1examprep.com). Phone: (877) 775-9400. Email: sales@1examprep.com.
- Sources: https://codes.iccsafe.org/ ; https://www.iapmo.org/ ; https://www.iccsafe.org/professional-development/certification/
